title: Pan-Seared Cod with Wicked Irish Skillet
description: A simple and flavorful cod dish cooked in a wicked irish skillet. Perfect for a keto diet.
instructions: Preheat the skillet in the oven at 400°F (200°C).
Season the cod with salt and pepper.
Add the Irish skillet oil to the preheated skillet and swirl to coat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cod fillets and cook for 3-4 minutes per side.
Remove the skillet from the oven and add the wicked butter.
Toss the chopped scallions with the butter and cook for 1 minute.
Serve the cod with the wicked butter and scallions, and a squeeze of lemon juice.
